DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-1.char: DARV! Mine dearest old friend! Art thou selling those dreadful wares still?
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2.ancie: ...Will you leave if I give ya something?
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-0r.anci: Don't ya have somewhere to be?
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0.char: If it is thine desire, I shall supplant thine drab, itchy robe for something of a finer standard.
DARV.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-1.char: Or... lo, hast thou coffers run dry? Must I provide... a [sine]'Freebie'?[/sine] For a [sine]'Friendie'???[/sine]
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-0.char: Hark, giant one! Wilt thou assist in mine quest to locate the Architect?
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.0-2.char: Thou darest cast thine doubt upon me? No matter! (I shall clandestinely purloin thine relic and depart with haste...)
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.1-1.char: Thine attitude offends me and thy breath reeketh of fishe.
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.2-0r.char: Lo, I requireth thy boon once more, blubbery creature!
NEOW.talk.THETAILOR-THE_TAILOR.4-0r.char: That slobbering pillock Architect hast the [jitter]GALL[/jitter] to deny me mine rightful reward?
ARCHITECT! I promised upon mine return. Now behold me, for I deliver consequences for thine misdeeds!
HARK! For I beseech thine penance, For this terrible thing which has been done,
For mine righteous judgement, so mote it be, Taketh no shape of sword or gun,
But a needle, to sew thine fate to mine own, For there is a debt to be repaid,
And I shall not rest upon mine laurels, Until this justice has been made.
Shall we discuss thine transgressions, Architect?
The finest garment of all, I hath made for thou... wherefore art mine compensation?
I don't recall any such exchange.
ARCHITECT! I return once more! Taste mine fury!
